description: Record the SHA-256 of a decision record you keep yourself, so it can later be shown to be unchanged. Send the digest and a short kind, never the record. Needs your RiskRouter key in the Authorization header of the MCP connection. Entries are permanent.

chain_seq.description: Optional, with chain_tag: this record's position in its chain, from 1.

chain_tag.description: Optional: the completeness chain this record belongs to (64 hex characters derived from a secret you keep).

kind.description: A short tag such as ai.decision.

record_digest.description: SHA-256 of your salted record, lowercase hex. Never the record itself.

name: record_evidence
title: Record the digest of a decision
